title: Intro to R
line: Vectors, data frames, dplyr and ggplot2. Turn a table into a chart.

project.title: An air quality report
project.brief: Write report.R on your own with the built-in airquality data. Work out the average wind speed per month with dplyr, save it as a CSV and chart it with ggplot2.
checks: report.R runs from top to bottom with no error
summary.csv has one row per month with the average wind speed
A PNG chart made with ggplot2 is saved

lessons.title: Run your first R script
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner to make an R script in RStudio, store a name and a birth year with the arrow assignment, print an age and run it line by line and all at once.
lessons.passes: The script runs with no error and prints an age as a number.

lessons.title: Vectors
lessons.goal: Teach R vectors, with c, indexing, vectorized math, mean, max and logical filters, by logging a week of commute times and finding the days over 40 minutes.
lessons.passes: The script prints the average, the slowest day and the days over 40 minutes.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.goal: Teach writing R functions with arguments, default values and return by building a score rescaler that maps a vector of exam scores onto 0 to 100.
lessons.passes: The lowest score prints as 0 and the highest as 100.

lessons.title: Data frames
lessons.goal: Teach R data frames, with data.frame, the dollar sign, nrow, str and adding a column, by building a table of five planets with diameter and moons.
lessons.passes: The table has five rows and a new column worked out from another.

lessons.title: Read and write a CSV
lessons.goal: Teach reading and writing CSV files in R with write.csv and read.csv by saving the planets table to planets.csv and loading it back.
lessons.passes: planets.csv exists and loads back as a data frame with five rows.

lessons.title: Filter, select and arrange
lessons.goal: Teach installing and loading dplyr in R and its verbs filter, select and arrange by making a shortlist of fuel-saving cars from the built-in mtcars table.
lessons.passes: The shortlist holds only cars over 25 mpg, highest mpg first.

lessons.title: Pipes and mutate
lessons.goal: Teach the R pipe and the dplyr verb mutate by building a metric version of the mtcars table with a kilometres per litre column, in one piped chain.
lessons.passes: The piped result has a new column of kilometres per litre.

lessons.title: Group and summarise
lessons.goal: Teach dplyr group_by and summarise in R by building a summary table of the average mpg and the number of cars for each cylinder count in mtcars.
lessons.passes: The summary has three rows, for 4, 6 and 8 cylinders, each with an average mpg.

lessons.title: A scatter plot with ggplot2
lessons.goal: Teach ggplot2 in R, with ggplot, aes, geom_point and labs, by drawing a scatter plot of car weight against mpg and saving it with ggsave.
lessons.passes: A PNG is saved that shows weight against mpg as points with axis labels.

lessons.title: A bar chart from a summary
lessons.goal: Teach geom_col, fill and titles in ggplot2 in R by turning the average mpg per cylinder count into a labeled bar chart saved as a PNG.
lessons.passes: A PNG is saved with one bar per cylinder count and a title.
